judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking black-and-white sky with dramatic, sculpted cumulus towers and strong depth, though the heavy contrast makes it feel somewhat overprocessed.
strengths: good sense of depth and scale
weaknesses: heavy monochrome processing feels a bit harsh
lack of color or landscape context
highlights are close to clipping in places
